source.publisher: Department of Education Regional Office I
source.coverage: Region I public basic-education schools (Sector=Public) listed in the SY 2022-2023 school-level enrollment workbook; name suggestions only, not a current register or school-offering/eligibility source.
source.extraction: Selected all Region I rows with Sector exactly Public from DATABASE rows 7–3407, including first school ID 100001; 2,861 distinct public-school IDs. Retained one row per BEIS School ID, including primary, elementary, high school, integrated, annex/extension, and special schools where present. School ID used only in provenance key, not as UI-required identity; no addresses, contact, or personal data included. Identical school labels disambiguated with municipality from source.
